job_purpose: one read-only cudaDeviceProp query on the real 5090, to settle whether the overlay's VALUES or its OFFSETS were wrong. ~1 second, no data generation, no queue contention (the queue was empty).
cpu_only_work: offsetof() probe against the real CUDA 13.3 headers, which established the offsets were CORRECT without touching a GPU at all
note: Submitting one tiny diagnostic query was the right call: the offsets were answerable on CPU, but the correct VALUES were not knowable without reading them off the part.
